001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.util.function.Supplier;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFeatureFlagContainerItem.FlagContainer;
007import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFeatureModelContainerItem.ModelContainer;
008import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
009
010/**
011 * Generates child node items for Metapath node items.
012 * <p>
013 * Provides methods to create lazy suppliers that generate child node items for
014 * field, assembly, and module node items in both data model and metaschema
015 * model contexts.
016 */
017public interface INodeItemGenerator {
018
019  /**
020   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
021   *
022   * @param item
023   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
024   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  Supplier<FlagContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem item);
028
029  /**
030   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
031   *
032   * @param item
033   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
034   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  Supplier<ModelContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item);
038
039  /**
040   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
041   *
042   * @param item
043   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
044   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
045   */
046  @NonNull
047  Supplier<ModelContainer> newDataModelSupplier(@NonNull IRootAssemblyNodeItem item);
048
049  /**
050   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
051   * <p>
052   * The provided item is based on a Metaschema module and has no associated
053   * value. As a result, the child items will have no associated value.
054   *
055   * @param item
056   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
057   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
058   */
059  @NonNull
060  Supplier<FlagContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem item);
061
062  /**
063   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
064   * <p>
065   * The provided item is based on a Metaschema module and has no associated
066   * value. As a result, the child items will have no associated value.
067   *
068   * @param item
069   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
070   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  Supplier<ModelContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item);
074
075  /**
076   * Generate the child Metapath node items for the provided item.
077   * <p>
078   * The provided item is a Metaschema module and has no associated value. As a
079   * result, the child items will have no associated value.
080   *
081   * @param item
082   *          the parent item to generate child node items for
083   * @return a container that consisting of the child node items
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  Supplier<ModelContainer> newMetaschemaModelSupplier(@NonNull IModuleNodeItem item);
087}
